maintainerAcceptance: This collection does not attest human review. Acceptance and maintenance dates must be recorded by the repository maintainer in the maintenance ledger.
scope: Weekly review preparation: eight existing maintenance sources, their canonical Markdown alternatives, four affected resource/permission sources, and all changes in the official written-doc and stable/preview-spec diffs from frozen discovery revisions. Support classifications below are proposals until maintainer acceptance. No discovery-wide freshness or live interoperability claim.
collectionMethod: Official HTML documentation was opened and inspected. System curl fetched exact original and canonical Markdown URLs using normal HTTPS certificate validation. The read-only review_upstream.py collector fetched exact pinned/current official Git revisions and collected complete patches. Its Python request used the host trusted CA file through SSL_CERT_FILE after the default Python certificate store failed verification; certificate verification remained enabled.
comparisonLimits: The 2026-10-28 snapshot committed response hashes and selected contract findings, not old raw response bodies. Current hashes can establish byte equality when identical; changed hashes do not provide a complete historical response-text diff. Git repository comparisons are exact pinned/current diffs and may overlap changes already reviewed after the frozen discovery pins.

findings.finding: A member already connected to a voice channel retains SET_VOICE_CHANNEL_STATUS even if CONNECT is denied. PermissionResolver previously removed bit 48 with the CONNECT-dependent mask.
findings.implementation: Remove bit 48 from the implicit CONNECT-denial mask. Preserve explicit overwrites, VIEW_CHANNEL denial and timeout masking. The arithmetic result does not establish connection state or authorize a server operation.

findings.finding: Four new GET routes return computed permissions as a string bitfield. Channel reads support implicit masking (default true), and target-bot member masking differs. Existing local permission arithmetic does not implement those network endpoints.
findings.implementation: No descriptors, authentication admission or response types for these routes are claimed. Keep these additions explicitly unsupported until a separate reviewed implementation.

findings.finding: New audit codes 16 and 33 describe channel/role position updates. Several actions can update an existing audit entry without another Gateway event; a merged batch retains its first reason.
findings.implementation: AuditLogEntry.actionType uses RawValue<AuditLogEvent>, preserving unknown integral codes, and options preserve exact raw fields. Named enum cases for 16/33 and complete audit-event coverage remain unsupported. Do not infer a complete immutable action stream from Gateway entry creation.

findings.finding: Attachment/embed scanning bits include explicit, gore and self-harm content; unfurled media has a separate optional content_scan_metadata.flags object. Scan results can arrive after initial creation via Message Update, and modal uploaded files do not yet have final message scan flags.
findings.implementation: Existing raw UInt64 flags and rawFields preserve new bits/objects. Named scan flags, a typed scan-metadata projection and a host moderation policy are not implemented; do not classify raw retention as semantic safety coverage.

findings.finding: The current forum/media starter-message flag table includes IS_COMPONENTS_V2. ThreadStartInForum currently rejects that bit.
findings.implementation: Retain the bounded helper limitation for this CI repair; a future extension must review response/component constraints and tests. Documentation must describe this as the helper limitation rather than the current upstream schema.

findings.finding: Other affected written resource changes clarify guild channel-position request fields and audit-reason support, optional role-connection request fields, and guild-unavailability descriptions.
findings.implementation: RoleConnectionUpdate already supports omitted platform fields and platform_username. Existing partial channel/guild catalog and cache contracts are not expanded by this review. Complete endpoint/protocol semantic parity is excluded.

findings.finding: Written diffs include previously announced OAuth iss guidance, implicit-grant cautions, native Social SDK token-expiry callbacks, cold-launch invite timing/provisional-account behavior and lobby callbacks.
findings.implementation: OAuthAuthorizationFlow already checks Discord issuer. Native Social SDK callbacks and client startup/lifecycle are outside the injected-provider Swift implementation support claim; this review does not add them.

findings.finding: Both stable/preview diffs also add optional nullable name fields to create/join/edit lobby requests, Letterboxd connection identification, embed audio schemas and additional unfurled-media metadata.
findings.implementation: Unknown response fields/values retain existing raw projections. New lobby name request fields and named connection/audio support are not claimed; the frozen discovery pins and historical verification rows are unchanged.

findings.finding: Remaining written diff paths adjust links, a game-stats video, documentation styles/snippets and documentation site dependencies.
findings.implementation: No DiscordKit runtime or support claim change is required for these documentation presentation changes.

existingContractFindings: The REST/Gateway reference still offers API version 10, and Gateway identity, heartbeat and resume ownership remain explicit.
Command identity remains application/type/name/scope with POST upsert, at most 25 options/choices, bounded group nesting, and partial autocomplete arguments with a focused marker.

Gateway/webhook interaction receipt stays mutually exclusive; initial responses retain the three-second deadline and continuation tokens retain fifteen-minute lifetime. Deferred message responses permit only EPHEMERAL, with Components V2 set by editing the original response.

Components V2 still uses IS_COMPONENTS_V2, allows forty total components, and disables legacy content, embeds, poll and stickers. Action-row and custom-ID limits remain unchanged in the selected contracts.
Message text and embed budgets remain 2000 content characters, ten embeds and a shared 6000-character text budget. Explicit allowed_mentions remains necessary for consistent edit behavior.

Interaction Create retains an Interaction inner payload. HTTP channel omission remains future-effective on 2026-11-16; no HTTP early opt-in is documented, and the transition fixtures remain unchanged.

proposedMaintenanceUpdate.status: apply only after the repository maintainer accepts the recorded classifications; use the actual acceptance date if it differs
